proof: CH and MAJ are bitwise expressions. Exhausting all eight Boolean input triples proves the displayed identities independently at every bit. For 32-bit e,f,g, M32 XOR e is their bitwise complement, so the existing CH equals g XOR (e AND (f XOR g)). No probabilistic hypothesis or carry assumption is used.
hypotheses: Each Counter XOR/AND/OR is one operation in this local expression count.

reviewed_call_context.gates_before_CH: Both the W9/F9 check and the W8/F8 check return immediately on failure before the CH helper is called.
reviewed_call_context.inputs: e1 and e0 are reduced by a32/s32; cv[4] must be a valid 32-bit chaining word.
reviewed_call_context.expression_only_saving: One Boolean operation for each execution that reaches this call, not one for every walk step or every raw claw.
reviewed_call_context.complete_price_status: NOT RECOUNTED; no gate probability or independence assumption is inferred.

scope_limits: This proves a one-operation local CH expression reduction, not optimality among all programs.
The 256-lane walk has a separately specialized constant-folding generator. Its cost cannot be reduced by mechanically subtracting this helper count from every walk step.
Dynamic helper frequencies, caller preconditions, extra moves, live registers, executable size and the complete charged numerator were not recounted.
The module and historical experiments were not imported or run; no production source was modified and no new attack score is claimed.
